Zedd is set to embark on the Telos Tour in September which will include stops in Los Angeles, Brooklyn, Dallas, Boston, Denver, Seattle, San Francisco, and more.

It’s hard to imagine that we’re now less than three months away from experiencing Zedd’s long-awaited third album, Telos. Although he’s produced countless numbers of pop singles since his 2015 sophomore record, True Colors, the producer was quiet on the album front until he made the surprising album announcement with a stunning drone show during his recent EDC Las Vegas performance.  ReserveFestival Tickets

Now, in support of the forthcoming project, the DJ is announcing the US leg of his new Telos Tour. Zedd in the Park, his September two-day event in Los Angeles, will kick off the new tour, and from there, Zedd will bring his colorful sounds and production to other cities such as Brooklyn, Washington DC, Boston, Dallas, and Austin. Zedd will conclude the run of shows with a two-night affair at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium in San Francisco on October 11-12, and the final show on October 15 at the famed Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Colorado.

Little is still known about this project, but according to Zedd, Telos will be his “most genuine and deeply personal album” to date. Also, no official singles have been released yet, but the Grammy winner did play a handful of IDs during his EDC Las Vegas set, and one can speculate that these unknown tracks will be featured on the upcoming record, which is set for release on August 30.

Fans can register for early access tickets through Zedd’s website. Presale starts this Wednesday, June 12, at 10am local time. Additionally, fans can also pre-save Telos ahead of its release on their preferred streaming platform.
